clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's worry over money in the spring of 1988 and her distance from your father over it by May 1988, then your brother's grades falling in the autumn of 1989, and your mother calmer once back at work by March 1990. The shifts in these months show your mother and brother reacting as the family moved through this loss.

clusters.name: Your mother Della told she had breast cancer, 1994–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother Della being told she had breast cancer in February 1995: your migraines began in March 1994 once you left for college in September 1993, you called your brother most nights by April 1994, then after your mother's diagnosis in February 1995 you stopped returning your brother's calls by June 1995, and stopped calling home by February 1996. Your relationship moves toward and then away from your brother and your distance from your mother sit beside this serious diagnosis, and the shifts in these months are yours alone.
